Also, it tends to burn up when you are using apps. Price: The iPhone 11 stands at about $409 and $521 Canadian.

The facial recognition is a great feature but I think I liked the fingerprint feature more. I have had several instances where my friends/family take my phone out of my hands and hold it up to my face so they can access my photos and such. The fingerprint reader makes it more likely that they won’t be able to get in. Overall, my experience with this phone is a 9/10. The money I spent was absolutely worth the iPhone 11. Would be happy to purchase from this seller again!

Front camera defective. The front-facing camera looked scratched and any photos taken with the front camera were very fuzzy and out of focus. The face ID recognition didn't work either. The rest of the phone seemed to work fine, but I was very disappointed by the front camera quality and returned it immediately.

Previous owner's data accessible and unable to reset. Must return this gift. **Update** - Resolved. Unable to reset without previous owner's Apple credentials (i.e. - Activation lock is active) and all his data, including photos/videos/contacts/apps, is accessible since no passcode is set! Crazy, to say the least. Was supposed to be a birthday gift, so pretty disappointed Amazon. Please make this right ASAP. ***Update*** Amazon customer service (call) sent a replacement in decent cosmetic condition, but one of the speakerphone/stereo speakers is producing no sound and the other sounds blown, with distortion during high-volume playback of relatively quiet videos. After contacting Amazon customer support, I was taken through a long series of troubleshooting efforts with an Apple technician, only to conclude what was readily apparent; the speakers were faulty. I've been waiting two weeks for the "escalation team" to call me and losing confidence quickly. Not a good experience at all.

iPhone is a solid choice. I don’t really have many complaints , the IPhone is a solid phone with many uses . Having come from a Google Pixel I can say the I’ll keep my Pixel around to take to concerts for photos and videos . The iPhone losses out to the Pixel when it comes to the camera , in my opinion.

Quality of the iPhones. This was a very good value for our money. Love the quality of the pictures it takes and the battery last a long time. Couldn’t be happier if it was a new one ! We actually bought two of them one black and one in red. Both are great!

Please read. I ordered two of these. One is absolutely fantastic. The other not so much. Both cameras in it are sub standard. It takes horrid photos. Like an old flip phone quality and the battery is already going south on it. I know it’s a referb . But can we use the proper pieces? It’s a 5050 shot when you buy this

for the price i can’t complain. came with a screen protector & non working off brand charger. scratches on back glass & dents on buffer. recently put a new screen protector on & noticed the front screen is completely wrecked with scratches. i bought refurbished, unlocked, 128gb, purple iphone 11. could be worse but not totally happy. i’ve bought several refurnished phone & this is definitely the worst i received. battery health good though. works really well all in all. takes great pictures. works as it should but cosmetically not worth 450$... clean IMEI, did have to connect to a computer to properly reset.
Bought in "excellent" condition. I purchased an iphone 11 in excellent condition, but the camera frame has a mark of a possible fall and the charger port looks like the bottom is burnt or dirty.

Worth it!!. I was pretty skeptical about this phone because it’s from Amazon, but it powered on fine, and I put the service card in the phone and it worked for the service! It takes beautiful pictures and there’s no scratches on it! The box came with the iPhone, a charger ( not an iPhone charger) and a screen protector! I bought this before Christmas and wanted to wait so I could give a better review! It still works great and I’ve had zero issues with this! So in my opinion, This is worth buying!
thrilled to own this. so far it works perfectly. I'm thrilled with this. Photos are great quality.

That the back of the phone is dirty when I open the box.. The phone delivery faster than a day that Amazon estimate. The battery life is 100% very good. But the phone is very dirty in the back, especially in the camera part. And the memory has been used 11GB for something that I do not know. I do not see any headphones here but it is all right no big problem. The fully unlock that I pick for the phone is working well with the T-Mobile sim card. The charge that Amazon provides charge phone really slow to get to 100% but I already have a wireless charger so no big issue with that. All of the things that I list above about the product that I buy make me feel happy because this is a trusted place to buy the phone. But I think you should buy an iPhone 12, the same price but better color than iPhone 11.

Photo Lenses cracked. I am hoping the manufacturer will reach out to us. I got this for my husband for Christmas, I know they are not suppose to be perfect; but I expected at least for it to take good photos. He started using yesterday and noticed right away the lenses are cracked, must be internal. We can’t see any damage and we got a case right away and he has not dropped it within the time he has had it.
Takes nice pictures. It takes really good pictures.
Not the best. The phone looks like its bent by the camera, always has a pop-up when the battery is low & says that its not a supportive apple battery in the phone.
The camera. Great condition

Camera. It’s good but it didn’t come with original packaging, camera was good but it had cracks that was scratched. Audio wasn’t working on the left it only worked on the right down below. Other than that it was pretty good. I just didn’t like the scratch marks by the camera lense.
